==Description==
'''E-120''' will be one of the many entity you will encounter in [[Section E]]. More information about it is shown below.

==Behavior==
Once spawned, it will place itself behind the door, open it after a few seconds and begin to wander around. '''E-120''' is blind, although it follows and chases anyone it hears, whether a player runs within the entity's proximity or hides near it. When '''E-120''' notices a player entering a locker or table, it will head to the hiding spot where the player has entered and force the player out. 

If a player is to approach the instance, '''E-120''' deals damage varying on the distance between eachother.

'''E-120''' will disappear after a few doors have been opened.

==Strategy & Tips==
* Simply try to walk past, it will only chase you if you sprint.
** If '''E-120''' is blocking the path, try to lure it away by sprinting or rolling through it. However, this can be risky.
* Once you open the door and '''E-120''' spawns, listen for other entities, and if you hear someone, walk to the previous room and hide, since '''E-120''' will pull players out of lockers if they hear them hide while it is nearby.

== Notes ==
* '''E-120''' is the single entity from this [[Section E|section]] which is vulnerable to [[Items#Weapons|weapons]] such as Glock 17, AK-47, APAR-16, etc.
* '''E-120''' loses hearing after being shot enough times and deals less damage to any player that makes contact with the entity.

==Lore==
'''E-120''' is possesed by multiple human souls. 

==Trivia==
* As stated by [[Oblivion]] in Misleading Darkness, if '''E-120''' wasn't blind, it would have killed every player that it'll see. 
* E-120 and [[False-120]] are the only 120 entities that dont have drumming sounds in their ambience.
* E-120 is the only (technically) blind entity within the entire game
